summary: misilva73 提交 EIP-8037 修改，把动态的每状态字节成本改为固定常量 CPSB = 1174，并加入 frame 计费规则。nixorokish 提交并合并 EIP-7773 更新，将 EIP-7979 与 EIP-8163 列为提议纳入。gakonst 宣布 access keys 上线，用受协议限制的密钥委托替代托管合约。

items.topic: 交易与 gas：EIP-8037 固定 CPSB
items.title: EIP-8037：固定 CPSB 与 frame 计费
items.note: （misilva73）提交：把动态量化的 cost_per_state_byte 替换为单一常量 CPSB = 1174，按 96M gas 参考上限下每年 100 GiB 状态增长目标推导；删除相关量化参数，新增存储写入、新账户、授权等字节数常量，并补充状态 gas 计费规则。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: fixed CPSB plus frame accounting
items.note_en: (misilva73), submitted: replaces the dynamic, quantized cost_per_state_byte with one constant CPSB = 1174, derived from a 100 GiB per year growth target at a 96M gas reference limit; removes the quantization parameters, adds byte count constants for storage sets, new accounts and authorizations, and adds state gas accounting rules.
items.topic_en: Transactions and gas: fixed CPSB in EIP-8037

keywords_en: EIP-8037 switches to a fixed cost per state byte and adds frame accounting
EIP-7773 lists EIP-7979 and EIP-8163 as PFI
ERC-7930 and ERC-7828 move to Review
summary_en: misilva73 submitted an EIP-8037 change that replaces the dynamic cost per state byte with a fixed constant CPSB = 1174 and adds frame accounting rules. nixorokish submitted and merged an EIP-7773 update proposing EIP-7979 and EIP-8163 for inclusion. gakonst announced access keys, replacing escrow contracts with protocol limited key delegation.
